task.title: Configuring ephemeral storage for managed Clair
task.shortdesc: To increase Clair scratch space for image layer extraction on Red Hat Quay, you can set volumeSize and storageClassName overrides on the managed clair component in the QuayRegistry custom resource.

context.p: When you deploy managed Clair, the Operator provisions an ephemeral volume named indexer-layer-storage for temporary image layer extraction during vulnerability scanning. If your registry scans large images, this scratch space can fill and cause Clair pods to fail.

By default, the ephemeral volume requests 20Gi of storage and uses the cluster default storage class. You can override the capacity and storage class without adding new fields to the QuayRegistry CR. The Operator applies these values to the ephemeral volume mounted at /var/tmp.

note.p: These overrides apply to Clair scratch storage at /var/tmp, not to the managed Clair PostgreSQL database. To resize the Clair database volume, configure overrides on the clairpostgres component.

step.cmd: Edit your QuayRegistry custom resource. For example:
Under spec.components, add overrides.volumeSize and, optionally, overrides.storageClassName to the managed clair component. For example:

info.codeblock: spec: components: - kind: clair managed: true overrides: volumeSize: 50Gi storageClassName: fast-ssd
info.p: When no overrides are specified, the Operator preserves the default 20Gi request and does not set a storage class.

step.cmd: Save the changes and wait for the Operator to reconcile the Clair deployment.
